purpose: Keep candidate JavaScript out of the trusted node:test process while exercising the package root through bounded one-shot JSON child calls.

operations.inspect: Read package metadata, resolve the safe ESM root export, import it in the candidate child, and return only public shape metadata.
operations.serialize: Call toMarkdown with one bounded JSON-compatible mdast tree and whitelisted options, returning the string, repeat-call results, and an input-mutation flag.
operations.extension-adapter: Construct fixed custom handler, extension-handler, and join callbacks inside the candidate child so callback behavior crosses no serialization boundary.
